pages.text: $(bold)Obtaining$() (Goety: Ladder crossover): melt the ladder mod's $(bold)Void Metal Ingot$() ($(bold)goety_ladder:void_metal$()) in a $(bold)smeltery/furnace$() into $(bold)Molten Void Metal$() (1 ingot = 90 mB), then cast the parts in a $(bold)casting table$() with the matching $(bold)cast$() (not a Part Builder material).$(br2)Parts: $(bold)all$() (head / handle / grip / limb / binding / repair kit / all four platings / shield core / maille).$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T4$() (same as Divine Gold).$(br2)Strength: $(bold)above Manyullyn, below Divine Gold$() (head 1550 durability / 7.5 mining / 7.0 melee; plating 3.0 / 8.0 / 6.5 / 3.0 armour, 3.5 toughness).

$(bold)Built-in tool traits$():$(li)$(bold)Void Touch$() (no levels): melee or ranged hits with a void metal tool inflict $(bold)Void Wane$() for 3 seconds; if the target already has it, its level goes $(bold)+1$(), up to $(bold)level 5$().$(li)$(bold)Soul Mending$(): spends soul energy to repair the tool while held or worn.$(li)$(bold)Ender Power$() (no levels, Iron's Spellbooks crossover): the tool is imbued with $(bold)Teleport Lv3$() and $(bold)Arcane Shackle Lv3$().

$(bold)Built-in armour traits$():$(li)$(bold)Void Grace$() (no levels): full immunity to damage and debuffs from $(bold)Void Blocks$() (goety:void_block) and $(bold)Liquid Void$() (goety:void_fluid); immunity to $(bold)Void-Touched$() and $(bold)Slowness$(); void spells cost $(bold)half$() the soul energy; $(bold)+20%$() void damage resistance.$(li)$(bold)Watcher's Will$() ($(bold)levelled, stacks across pieces$()): each level gives a $(bold)10%$() dodge chance and $(bold)+15%$() casting speed for both $(bold)Goety$() and $(bold)Iron's Spellbooks$().$(br2)$(italic)The greatest feat, engraved upon the End!$()
